_meta.tweak_via: edit this file + commit; scripts/cost_by_repo.py reads it on each run (no service reload).
_meta.rationale: Config-driven inputs for per-repo cost attribution. `sources`/`source_suffixes` classify which costs.jsonl rows are recurring INFRA/chat spend (not attributable to a single build repo) — these are bucketed as INFRA with strict precedence over per-repo/unattributed. `monthly_usd` is a static line-item tally of recurring dollar infra (SaaS subscriptions) that never appears in costs.jsonl at all; it is reported alongside the LLM buckets as a separate fixed-cost line. All values are placeholders — edit freely.
